items.text:
Pretty fun in the first few hours illegally salvaging ships. Hired a crew member, then killed them because they wouldn't stop talking to my character. 

Second character was shook down by a patrol officer while salvaging air pumps. Took all my tools, fined me $15000, and then once he detached from my ship it was struck by something. Immediately destroying my nav console and leaving a gaping unrepairable hole in my ship. Couldn't crawl to station because no screen to repair nav console. 

Third character i decided would just repair their free ship they got. Almost immediately hit by something destroying the ship completely, didn't even get to sit in the nav console to see what it was. 

It's still in early access so i'm gonna give it a thumbs up but they should add some sort of grace period after creating your character or just spawn you at the damn station. Gonna be a fun game when it's finished.
items.text_zh:
前几个小时非法打捞飞船还挺好玩的。雇了一个船员，然后把他杀了，因为他一直跟我的角色说话停不下来。

第二个角色在打捞空气泵的时候被一个巡逻警官敲诈了。拿走了我所有的工具，罚了我15000美元，然后等他从我的船上脱离后，船被什么东西撞了。立刻摧毁了我的导航控制台，并在我的船上留下了一个无法修复的大洞。因为没屏幕修导航控制台，没法爬到空间站。

第三个角色我决定就修修他们免费得到的船。几乎立刻被什么东西撞了，船完全被摧毁，甚至还没来得及坐到导航控制台前看看那是什么。

它还在抢先体验阶段，所以我会给它一个赞，但他们应该在创建角色后加某种宽限期，或者干脆把你生成在该死的空间站。等它完成时会是个好玩的游戏。

Running out of money = start over
Salvaging = time dilation / boring game play loop
